questions.title: Which month will the Palestinian Football Association announce for the resumption of its football competitions after their October 2023 suspension?
questions.background: Palestinian football competitions have been suspended since the war in Gaza began in October 2023.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : An official Palestinian Football Association announcement, or reliable news reporting quoting its leadership. Resolution Conditions : Use the first public announcement between July 1 and August 31, 2026, that specifies a date for restarting the suspended football competitions. Resolve to the calendar month containing that announced restart date, regardless of whether competitions subsequently begin as scheduled. If no qualifying announcement occurs by the deadline, the question is void. Accepted Answer Format : The full English name of the month, not the month in which the announcement is made.

questions.title: Which stadium will Shakhtar Donetsk announce an agreement to use for its home matches in the main phase of the 2026–27 UEFA Champions League?
questions.background: War has prevented Shakhtar Donetsk from hosting European matches in Ukraine, forcing the club to arrange alternative venues abroad.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : An official Shakhtar Donetsk announcement, or reliable reporting quoting the club, identifying its agreed home venue for the 2026–27 Champions League main phase. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the stadium named in the first such agreement announced by August 31, 2026. The announcement determines the answer; subsequent regulatory approval or the actual staging of matches is not required. Accepted Answer Format : The stadium’s name.

questions.title: Which two countries will reach the final of the 2026 Women's Africa Cup of Nations?
questions.background: The Women's Africa Cup of Nations is Africa's continental championship for women's national football teams. The winners of its two semifinals advance to the final.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : CAF's official tournament results, supported where necessary by contemporaneous match reporting. Resolution : Resolve once both semifinals of the 2026 Women's Africa Cup of Nations have concluded and the two finalists have been determined. The result of the final itself is not relevant. Accepted Answer Format : The two finalist country names in alphabetical order, separated by a comma.

questions.title: What will be the furthest stage Inter Miami reaches in the 2026 Leagues Cup?
questions.background: The Leagues Cup features clubs from Major League Soccer and Mexico’s Liga MX. Inter Miami won the tournament in 2023 and finished as runners-up in 2025.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official Leagues Cup results or reliable contemporaneous match reports covering Inter Miami’s participation in the 2026 tournament. Resolution Condition : Resolve once Inter Miami is eliminated or completes the tournament final. The answer is the furthest tournament stage in which the club plays. Accepted Answer Format : Provide only the name of the tournament stage.

questions.title: Which country will the Spanish Football Federation announce as the host of the 2027 Spanish Super Cup?
questions.background: The Spanish Super Cup features the winners and runners-up of La Liga and the Copa del Rey. Saudi Arabia has hosted the competition since 2020.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The Spanish Football Federation’s official host announcement, corroborated by reliable news reporting. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the country officially named as host of the 2027 Spanish Super Cup by August 31, 2026. This question concerns the announced host, not whether the tournament subsequently takes place there. Resolution occurs when the announcement is made. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the host country, rather than the host city or stadium.

questions.title: Which club will lead Major League Soccer's Eastern Conference at the end of play on August 19, 2026?
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official MLS Eastern Conference standings, applying the league's official tiebreaking rules if necessary Resolution Date : 2026-08-19 (after all matches dated August 19, 2026) Accepted Answer Format : The club's name

questions.title: Which club will win the 2026 FA Community Shield?
questions.background: The FA Community Shield is English football's traditional curtain-raiser ahead of the domestic league season.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The Football Association's official match result or reliable contemporaneous reporting of the result. Resolution Condition : Resolve to the club that wins the 2026 FA Community Shield, including a victory by penalty shootout if applicable. Accepted Answer Format : The winning club's name.

questions.title: Which country will win the 2026 Women’s Africa Cup of Nations?
questions.background: The Women’s Africa Cup of Nations is Africa’s continental championship for senior women’s national football teams.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The Confederation of African Football’s official result for the 2026 Women’s Africa Cup of Nations final. Resolution : Resolve to the country whose national team is declared champion following the final. Accepted Answer Format : The country’s name.

questions.title: Who will be appointed to succeed Pape Thiaw as head coach of Senegal's men's national football team by August 31, 2026?
questions.background: The Senegalese Football Federation is responsible for appointing the national team's head coach.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : An official announcement by the Senegalese Football Federation, as confirmed by contemporaneous reliable news reporting. Resolution : Resolve to the person publicly announced as Pape Thiaw's successor between August 1 and August 31, 2026. The resolution date is the date the appointment is publicly announced, rather than the coach's presentation or first match. Accepted Answer Format : The appointed coach's full name.

questions.title: Who will win Nottingham Forest's opening Premier League match of the 2026–27 season?
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The official Premier League result for Nottingham Forest's first league fixture of the 2026–27 season. Resolution : Resolve according to the result at full time, including stoppage time. Preseason and cup fixtures do not count. Accepted Answer Format : The winning club's name, or “Draw” if the match finishes level.

questions.title: Which club will win Manchester United's opening match of the 2026–27 Premier League season?
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The official Premier League match result, corroborated by contemporaneous reporting from established sports news outlets. Resolution : Resolve according to the full-time result of Manchester United's opening Premier League fixture, scheduled for August 22, 2026. Accepted Answer Format : Return the winning club's name. If the match finishes level, return “Draw”.

questions.title: Which UEFA competition's league phase will Celtic enter in the 2026–27 season?
questions.background: Celtic are seeking a place in the 2026–27 UEFA Champions League through the qualifying playoffs.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : UEFA's official qualification results, corroborated by contemporaneous match reporting. Resolution Rule : Resolve to the European competition whose league phase Celtic qualify for following the completion of their August 2026 Champions League qualifying-playoff tie. Accepted Answer Format : The competition's standard name.

questions.title: Who will win the PFA Men's Players' Player of the Year award for the 2025–26 season?
questions.background: The Professional Footballers’ Association (PFA) presents annual awards recognizing outstanding players in English professional football, with winners selected by fellow players.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The PFA’s official announcement of its Men's Players' Player of the Year award for the 2025–26 season, or reliable news reporting of that announcement. Resolution : Resolve when the winner is publicly announced. Accepted Answer Format : The winning player's full name.
